_comment_InstallerPath: CUSTOMIZE: Set the absolute path to the installer executable to verify.
_comment_ExpectedPublisher: CUSTOMIZE: Set the exact CN or O publisher name expected on the Authenticode certificate.
_comment_ExpectedSHA256: CUSTOMIZE: Optional expected SHA-256 hex digest of the installer file, or empty string to skip hash verification.
_comment_ExpectedComputer: CUSTOMIZE: Optional host name where this check must be executed, or empty string to allow any host.
